purpose: Ask for one JSON document conforming to a supplied JSON Schema, so validity, conformance, type correctness, enum adherence and nesting can be checked mechanically.
system: Answer with one JSON document and nothing else. No prose, no explanation, no code fence.

task.description: What the JSON document should describe, in one sentence.

schema_json.description: Canonical JSON of the JSON Schema the answer must conform to — the same document the scorer validates against, so the model is never asked for a shape different from the one being checked.

expectations: One JSON document conforming to the supplied schema, with no surrounding text.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.structured_output needs the schema in the prompt as well as in the scorer, so a provider without schema enforcement is still asked for the right shape.
